name: steam-reviews-scraper
title: Steam Reviews Scraper – Playtime, Keyword & Language Filters
description: Steam player reviews and store data to JSON/CSV: review text, playtime, thumbs up/down, helpfulness votes, purchase type. Filter by minimum playtime, keyword, language or review type; games mode adds price, genres, review-score summary and live player count. No login, no browser, no key.
